d:
Japan pulled off an INCREDIBLE comeback against Lebanon in the FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers!
After falling behind by 14 points on the road, Japan refused to give up and fought their way back into the game!
Lebanon had a 13-point lead at halftime, but Japan came out firing in the second half, outscoring the Cedars 48-31 to complete an UNBELIEVABLE comeback!
Josh Hawkinson was a MONSTER, finishing with 24 POINTS and 15 REBOUNDS, while Makoto Hiejima delivered clutch plays to help Japan take control!
